info.title: FinTrack by Finnet Technologies API
info.description: FinTrack by Finnet Technologies. Real cookie-session API with PostgreSQL (Supabase) or local SQLite persistence. Get /auth/csrf before mutations; keep the cookie jar and send X-CSRF-Token. Access/refresh tokens are HttpOnly cookies and never returned in JSON. Registration requires email confirmation; Google and email MFA are optional account features. Canonical /api/v1 and compatibility /api expose the same protected routes.
